overview.description: The DoubleLine Securitized Credit ETF (DSCO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund focuses on structured products credit of various maturities and quality. The actively managed fund targets USD-denominated securitized credit investments from both government and private sectors. DSCO was launched on Feb 2, 2026 and is issued by DoubleLine.
